title: Seferî Tulipa Scented Candle
body_html:
This scented candle is presented in a fluted glass body that transforms the light into a soft glow. Its gold-toned base and lid add an elegant accent to the design. The top notes reveal the fresh, luminous effect of bergamot. At the heart, a refined floral bouquet of jasmine, tuberose, and gardenia adds richness and a soft depth to the fragrance. In the base notes, musk leaves a warm and long-lasting impression, balancing the composition. Material: body and lid glass, lid ornament and base brass. 220 g. Burn time: 28 hours. Made in Türkiye.

Dimensions
  • R: 10 cm
  • H: 18 cm
Care Instructions
  • Clean with a damp cloth.
  • Store at room temperature.

title: Seferî Cinnamon Scented Candle
body_html:
This scented candle is presented in a fluted glass vessel that transforms the light into a soft, warm glow. Gold-toned base and a coordinating lid add an elegant touch to the design. Its fragrance pyramid is composed to create a warm and inviting atmosphere. The top notes open with the brightness of aldehydes, fresh leafy nuances, a subtle peppery accent, and a hint of plum. In the heart, cinnamon, clove, nutmeg, and rose blend into a warm, spicy-floral harmony that adds depth to the composition. In the base, balsamic facets, the powdery softness of heliotrope, and the warmth of praline and vanilla come together, bringing the scent to a warm and lasting finish. Material: body and lid glass, lid ornament and base brass. 220 g. Burn time: 28 hours. Made in Türkiye.

Dimensions
  • R: 10 cm
  • H: 18 cm
Care Instructions
  • Clean with a damp cloth.
  • Store at room temperature.

title: Amber Candle
body_html:
Amber has been prized for centuries for its warm, earthy aroma, which is both exotic and alluring. The scent is also reminiscent of the ancient markets and bazaars that have flourished throughout Türkiye and Anatolia for thousands of years, where spices, textiles, and precious stones are traded. Lighting a candle with this scent creates a warm and inviting atmosphere, providing an ideal space for reflection and relaxation. Top notes: Bergamot. Middle notes: Cumin, Cinnamon, Clove, Sandalwood. Base notes: Vanilla, Amber. Enjoy its fragrance during its burning time of approximately 45 hours.

Dimensions
  • R: 7 cm
  • H: 9 cm
Care Instructions
  • Clean with a damp cloth.
  • Store at room temperature.
  • Do not expose to direct sunlight.

title: Fig Candle
body_html:
Fig is a celebration of the lush and fertile lands of Türkiye, Anatolia and the Mediter-ranean. The fig tree has long been a symbol of abundance, fertility, and prosperity, and its sweet and delicate fragrance evokes the warmth and sun-drenched beauty of the region. This candle is a tribute to the rich cultural heritage of the area, where the fig has played an important role in art, literature and mythology. Top notes: Fig leaf, Green foliage Middle notes: Fig. Base notes: Tonka Bean, Coconut, Fig tree. Enjoy its fragrance during its burning time of approximately 45 hours.

Dimensions
  • R: 7 cm
  • H: 9 cm
Care Instructions
  • Clean with a damp cloth.
  • Store at room temperature.
  • Do not expose to direct sunlight.

title: Hamam Candle
body_html:
"Hamam" captures the essence of the Turkish bath experience, which is all about cleansing and purification. The scent is fresh and clean, evoking a sense of calm and purity. It brings to mind the warm and steamy atmosphere of the Hamam, a cornerstone of Turkish culture, where the body is thoroughly cleaned. Lighting a candle with this scent creates a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere, providing a space for renewal and rejuvenation. Top notes: Peach, Apricot. Middle notes: Rose, Hyacinth, Lilac. Base notes: Tonca Bean, Vanilla, White musk. Enjoy its fragrance during its burning time of approximately 45 hours.

Dimensions
  • R: 7 cm
  • H: 9 cm
Care Instructions
  • Clean with a damp cloth.
  • Store at room temperature.
  • Do not expose to direct sunlight.

title: Rose Candle
body_html:
The Anatolian rose, grown in the fertile lands of Türkiye, has a unique and intoxicating scent that is both delicate and powerful. Its aroma is reminiscent of the rolling hills of Anatolia, the vibrant colors of its fields, and the warm sun that bathes this land. Lighting a candle with the scent of an Anatolian rose brings a sense of tranquility, peace, and beauty, transporting you to a world of wonder and magic. Top notes: Lime, Bergamot, Saffron. Middle notes: : Rose. Base notes: Musk, Patchouli, Guaiacwood, Agarwood. Enjoy its fragrance during its burning time of approximately 45 hours.

Dimensions
  • R: 7 cm
  • H: 9 cm
Care Instructions
  • Clean with a damp cloth.
  • Store at room temperature.
  • Do not expose to direct sunlight.
